Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.kwebdemo1.singletons

Class EdgeData

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.kwebdemo1.singletons.EdgeData
public class EdgeData extends Object
James Burke's Knowledge Web graph edge data.

Note: This class is autogenerated from a Perl 5.8 script, create_EdgeData.pl located in the tools subdirectory. DO NOT EDIT THIS CODE DIRECTLY.

This is only a small portion of the complete KWeb graph for the purposes of this demo only. The full dataset is copyrighted under a different copyright agreement. Only this portion is used by permission of the Burke Institute and put under the GNU General Public License.

This class is normally used in conjunction with the NodeData class which contains the graph node details that the edges in this Class create associations between.

Since:
JDK 1.5.0, Java3D 1.4.0, lg3d-{core,demo,incubator} 0.7.0

    • getEdge

      public BasicEdge getEdge(String srcNodeId, String dstNodeId)
      Get a directed edge object connecting a pair of nodes. Because edges are directed there can be, and often are, two edges connecting a pair of nodes. Only the edge specified in the source to destination direction is returned, (if any). The edge for the reverse direction (if any) can be obtained by transposing the two parameters. (Only strings containing numerics have any hope of success.) While the Edge object returned is a BasicEdge, the actual object is likely to be a derived class object. See the Edge class references in this class declaration (above).
      Parameters:
      srcNodeId - Node ID of the edge source node.
      dstNodeId - Node ID of the edge destination node
      Returns:
      an Edge Object or null if none
